# Use a template to deploy and manage an application

This page describes how to create an Terraform Developer Portal application using a template. Application engineers often perform this task. Refer to [Templates](/terraform/cloud-docs/developer-portal/concepts/templates) for additional information.

## Background

Terraform Developer Portal templates are common infrastructure patterns created and maintained by platform engineers. This ensures that any infrastructure provisioned using templates is compliant with your organization's policies for security, finance, scaling, and more. Application developers use these standardized templates to deploy their applications without worrying about the underlying infrastructure.

## Prerequisites

- An HCP Terraform Standard edition account with permission to create workspaces. Refer to HCP Terraform pricing for more details. 
- A Terraform Developer Portal template to deploy. Refer to Create and manage templates for more information. 

## Create an application

To create an application, complete the following steps:

1. Sign in to [HCP Terraform](https://app.terraform.io/) and select the organization where you want to create your application. 
1. In the navigation menu, click **Developer Portal**.
1. Click **Applications** in the sidebar, then click **New Application**.
1. Choose the template you want to use to create your application. 
1. Click **Next**. 
1. Configure the settings for your new application, including the application **Name** and **Terraform project**. If you configured your template to let users provide values for the input variables, HCP Terraform includes inputs for each variable. 
1. Click **Create application**. 
1. HCP Terraform shows the application overview page. Use this page to monitor the status of application deployment progress and read through the developer instructions. 

## Update an application

When you update the module version in HCP Terraform, every application deployed from a template that uses that module displays a notification that you can update the application. HCP Terraform does not automatically update applications. The owner of the application must respond to the update notification to upgrade the application, and HCP Terraform prompts for values for any new input variables. For more information on updating a no-code module's version, refer to the [designing no-code modules](terraform/cloud-docs/no-code-provisioning/module-design#updating-a-module-s-version) documentation. 

If the new module version has a new input variable, you must first update the template settings to either provide a default value for the variable or allow the value to be supplied when the template is deployed. 

To update an application that has a new version available: 

1. Sign in to [HCP Terraform](https://app.terraform.io/) and select the organization where you want to update your application.
1. In the navigation menu, click **Developer Portal**. 
1. Click **Applications** in the sidebar, then click the name of the application to update. 
1. Click **View upgrade**. 
1. Enter values for any new input variables. 
1. Click **Save configuration & start plan**. 
1. Click **Go to run details**. 
1. Review the plan output, then click **Confirm & apply** to apply the upgrade. 

Terraform Developer Portal automatically starts a plan run in HCP Terraform. If the plan completes successfully, HCP Terraform automatically starts an apply run to upgrade the workspace. 

## Delete an application

Deleting an application removes the HCP Terraform workspace and resources associated with the application.

To delete an application, complete the following steps:

1. Sign in to [HCP Terraform](https://app.terraform.io/) and select the organization where you want to delete your application.
1. In the navigation menu, click **Developer Portal**. 
1. Click **Applications** in the sidebar, then click the application you want to delete. 
1. Click the **Manage** menu and select **Delete**. 
1. In the dialog, enter "delete" and click **Delete**.
